sentence: This project studies the ethical and social issues that robotic kitchens raise for child development, cultural traditions and food safety.
This project studies how temperature and mechanical stress cause fatigue damage and cracks where a semiconductor meets a metal.
This project holds a conference where researchers share results in quantum topology, geometric topology and hyperbolic geometry.
This project studies entropy, a measure of randomness, in dynamical systems and in algebras that describe quantum mechanics.
This project develops methods that use text to estimate how the effect of a cause differs for different groups.
This project builds scheduling methods and tools so that safety-critical tasks can share memory and still meet timing constraints.
This project studies how heating 3D printed metals afterward changes their inner grains, aiming for the same strength in every direction.
This project builds a microscope that combines electrical and optical methods to test electrocatalysts one at a time.
This project gathers genomic data from suboscine birds to draw a complete phylogeny and sort out which species and subspecies exist.
This project builds learning methods for decision-making that keep working when the data they learn from is noisy or corrupted.
This project uses sensors and a data platform to study how climate change, mining and pipeline failures affect wild rice and wetlands.
This project builds software that helps people set up and run ocean simulations for regions of the ocean and compare them with observations.
This project adds a research-based biology course that isolates bacteriophages from soil and studies their genomes.
This project builds training modules that show how connected devices, machine learning, robotics and cybersecurity can be used in construction management and safety.
This project studies how toxin-antitoxin systems in a soil bacterium help it form biofilms and pass DNA between cells.
This project builds a light-based printing method that makes electronic structures from metal and polymer in a single step.
This project studies whether people who are blind or have low vision can learn to use telerobots for work.
This project teaches cybersecurity, including digital forensics, network security engineering and secure cloud computing.
